artifact_schema.description: The discrete logarithm k, as 96 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

k.description: k with k*G = Q, in [1, n), zero-padded to exactly 96 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

statement: Find the discrete logarithm k for the NIST P-384 curve: k*G = Q. The checker pins the NIST SP 800-186 domain parameters and derives Q by trying x-coordinates from SHAKE256(seed || counter), selecting the first curve point and choosing its y parity from the digest. The seed is cairn/nist-prime-curve-dlog/p384/v1. This deterministic construction does not choose k. Submit k in [1,n), as exactly 96 lowercase hexadecimal digits. The order n is prime and the curve cofactor is 1, so the answer is unique in this range. The derived target is Q=(f22211c8eb2ec1b01e08b60eb2670cab96d93ee94d62fc912f1500ebbffda9027885890d5f0076db6ecae7130d7471ff, e9553f42bb0e2b7b405139828d0debce7a1e4ed336dc18214765cdd22703ab8353793ec0e369dc585a660fd99c1c17b5); the first valid counter is 1.
